content: In the DELIVER trial, dapagliflozin was shown to effectively reduce the risk of hospitalizations due to heart failure in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) as well as those with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). Furthermore, the use of dapagliflozin led to significant improvements in patients' functional capacity and alleviated heart failure-related symptoms. These findings highlight dapagliflozin as an important therapeutic option for managing heart failure across varying ejection fraction profiles.
